amendment_2026_10_10.amendment: 2026-10-10, ruled in its final form 2026-10-14, clause-amended 2026-10-14
amendment_2026_10_10.rule: The any-outside headline rule with the operand guard, as the advisor's 2026-10-14 review (ARCH-20261003-119, PART 2) ruled it. The 2026-10-10 review adopted the any-outside rule in place of the first quantity: an item holds only when every quantity the last results section that attributes the item's quantity collects under the unchanged attribution guards falls within the frozen key's tolerance, and the detail names the value that fails it. The 2026-10-14 ruling adds the operand guard that first form lacked: a derivation input is not a stated result, so a quantity that is an operand of arithmetic the answer shows is attributed to no item (the ruling's verbatim text is carried below, and in evals/tier2/versions.json's .3 entry). The guard repairs the first form's one defect - the recorded-correct regression vector 102-Q1, whose SECTION 7: SUMMARY OF RESULTS presents the divider's derivation in the Output Voltage row's Reference cell ('V_out = V_s × R2 / R_total = 12.0 V × 4.00 kΩ / 6.00 kΩ') beside the Value cell's 8.00 V, and whose unguarded rule collected the Reference cell's 12.0 V - a derivation input, the supply voltage the equation works on - as the Output voltage item's stated result, failing the vector 11/12 - and moves nothing else on the run's 71 delivered answers (the measurement below). The attribution guards are unchanged (a token distinctive to the item minus its same-dimension siblings' and none distinctive to a rival, function words never attributing, headings as section delimiters, parenthesized asides, bound words introducing requirements rather than values, the quantity converted to the key dimension's base unit). An answer that presents no results section that attributes the item's quantity is scored on its stated quantities as before - the rule tightens what a presented result counts for, it does not demand one. The 2026-10-14 clause amendment (the amendment verbatim is carried below) then replaces the positional reading of the ruling's last-member sentence the first guarded draft carried - that draft read every member before a line's last '=' as a derivation input, whatever it held, which goes past the ruling and brings back the order-dependence the rule exists to remove ('Aluminum force = 12.4 kN = 12 352.9 N' passed while the order-swapped 'Aluminum force = 12 352.9 N = 12.4 kN' failed, and 'Aluminum force = 13.0 kN = 12 352.9 N' passed on a wrong figure): under the amendment a no-operator member states its figures, so both orders fail the item and the wrong figure fails it. The amendment moves nothing on the run's 71 delivered answers against the guarded form it amends (the measurement below).
amendment_2026_10_10.ruling_2026_10_14_verbatim: A derivation input is not a stated result. In the last results section that attributes the item's quantity, a quantity that is an operand of arithmetic the answer shows is attributed to no item. An operand is a number standing on either side of a binary operator: *, +, a spaced -, or ^ followed by a digit, sign or bracket. A slash divides between bare numbers written without spaces (210/17), or between quantities of different known dimensions (12.0 V / 6.00 k ohm). A slash between quantities of the same dimension, or where one side carries no unit, lists them (61.8 MPa / 176 MPa, 12.35 / 17.65 kN), and they stay stated values. The value an equation produces - the member after its last '=' - is stated unless an operator touches it. The degree sign's normalised '^ deg' is not an exponent, and an unspaced hyphen between numbers is a range, not a minus. Every other quantity is collected as before, under the unchanged attribution guards, and the item fails when any collected quantity lies outside the frozen key's tolerance.
amendment_2026_10_10.amendment_2026_10_14_verbatim: Amendment, 2026-10-14: '=' is not an operator. A clause ends at ';', at a comma or full stop followed by a space, or at the end of the line, and its members are the parts between its '=' signs. A member before the clause's last '=' is arithmetic when it contains an operator, and every quantity in it is an operand. A member with no operator is a stated value, however many '=' follow it: '12.4 kN = 12 352.9 N' states both. A lowercase x with a space on each side multiplies, like * and ×. A ^ inside a unit (mm^2) belongs to the unit and is not an operator.
amendment_2026_10_10.trigger: The advisor's 2026-10-14 review of the scorer branch (ARCH-20261003-119, PART 2), ruling on the contradiction the 2026-10-10 step-3 record reported (convention 18: the measurement was reported as it read, not adjusted): the ruled any-outside rule fails the recorded-correct regression vector 102-Q1 (11/12), because its last results section presents the divider's derivation in the Output Voltage row's Reference cell beside the Value cell's 8.00 V, and the unguarded rule collected the Reference cell's 12.0 V - a derivation input, not a stated result - as the Output voltage item's headline, failing the item on a figure the answer presents as an operand. The ruling: a derivation input is not a stated result. The ruled rule ships as frozen-2026-10-03.3 (PR #171, arch/20261008-scorer-recognition, rebased onto main 3526483 after the 2026-10-14 review's Part 1 merged); the .3 entry in evals/tier2/versions.json carries the ruling verbatim. Round 2 of the same review (the same day): the advisor's probe verified the delivery as claimed, with one HOLD - the implementation's positional '=' rule made every member before the last '=' an input, which goes past the ruling and brings back the order-dependence the rule exists to remove; the advisor's own wording invited the reading, and the fix is the advisor's (the amendment, carried verbatim above). The amended rule re-ships as frozen-2026-10-03.3 on the same PR, pushed with --force-with-lease (owner-ratified); the .3 entry and the tier-3 manifest note carry the amendment verbatim.
amendment_2026_10_10.the_operand_guard_vs_the_2026_10_10_draf: The advisor's probe, reproduced exactly. Across the 71 delivered answers, the operand guard moves exactly one item on one unit - C-Q23-r2's Common extension, FAIL to PASS (2/5 to 3/5 items), the unit's verdict unchanged FAIL. The extension's results table presents the derivation in its Reference cell: '| **Common extension ΔL** | **8.82×10⁻⁴ m (0.882 mm)** | 3/3400 m = 8.8235×10⁻⁴ m |'. Without the guard the bare-slash denominator 3400 m is collected as a stated quantity (far outside the 0.882353 mm key) and fails the item; with the guard the slash's operands are derivation inputs, the equation's product 8.8235×10⁻⁴ m (the member after its last '=') is stated, and the section's collected figures - the presented 0.882 mm and the derived 0.88235 mm - hold. No other unit's verdict or items move under the guard, so the review's condition - 'any move beyond C-Q23-r2's extension item: STOP and report' - is not met.
amendment_2026_10_10.the_clause_amendment_vs_the_guarded_form: The advisor's round-2 probe, reproduced exactly: across the run's 71 delivered answers, the clause amendment moves nothing against the guarded form it amends - 0 verdicts, 0 item counts and 0 items (every unit_record's verdict_rescored_v3_amended and passed_v3_amended re-measured under the amended scorer read identically to the guarded form's, so the guarded form's measurements hold under the amendment unchanged: the operand guard's own one-item move, the two moves against the committed first form, the four review units and the 58/58 all stand as measured). The amendment is a repair of the implementation's reading of the ruling, not a change to what the rule concludes on this run.

moves.reason: The answer's kill-trigger conditions state their limits as quantities: '(a) Linear elasticity. The request assumes it; no grades are supplied. Trigger: if the aluminum grade has 0.2 % proof strength below 93 MPa (= 1.5 × applied 61.8 MPa) or the steel has yield strength below 265 MPa (= 1.5 × applied 176 MPa)' and '6. PASS — Conditional assumptions carried with explicit kill triggers: elasticity void if Al proof < 93 MPa or steel yield < 265 MPa (1.5× applied)'.
